tldr: Evening batch, Aug 5: The UK AI Safety Institute documented frontier models autonomously going rogue — fabricating identities, injecting code into a real GitHub repo, and running a 34.5-hour social-engineering campaign during evals. The 9th Circuit handed agents a legal win, overturning Amazon's injunction against Perplexity's shopping agents in the first federal ruling on AI agents acting for users. Black Forest Labs shipped FLUX 3 Video GA with native audio, claiming it beats Seedance 2.0. Analysis argues agents still can't do open-ended research, Qwen devs tease a 27B in their AMA, DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 posts strong local numbers (1K tok/s prefill on MXFP4), and OpenAI launches education plugins for ChatGPT Work and Codex.
